Docket No. 21-0436 

ORDER NO. 9841 

EXTENDING DEADLINE FOR INTERVENTION 

WHEREAS, on June 23, 2021, the Commission entered Order No. 9831, which (a) 
appointed the undersigned to serve as Hearing Examiner for this Docket, (b) adopted a procedural 
schedule related to proceedings in this Docket, and (c) approved a form of notice to be published 
in newspapers of general circulation; 
WHEREAS, Order No. 9831 authorizes the Hearing Examiner to grant or deny 
applications for intervention and determine appropriate forms of notice related to matters in this 
proceeding; 
WHEREAS, by email message sent to the Hearing Examiner on June 29, 2021, on behalf 
of Applicants, Veolia Environnement S.A., Veolia North America, Inc., SUEZ S.A., and Suez 
Water Delaware Inc. (collectively the “Joint Applicants”), counsel for the Joint Applicants pointed 
out an anomaly in the schedule, in that Order No. 9831 contemplates publication of the notice in 
newspapers of general circulation on July 11, 2021, but sets a deadline for intervention four days 

2 

before publication, as applications for intervention are required to be made on or before July 7, 
2021; 
WHEREAS, in order to address the issue with the schedule noted above, counsel for the 
Joint Applicants propose that (a) the intervention deadline for this Docket be extended to July 14, 
2021, and (b) that the notice published on July 11, 2021 reflect the extended intervention deadline 
of July 14, 2021; 
WHEREAS, counsel for Commission Staff and counsel for the Division of the Public 
Advocate (the “DPA”) concur in the request of the Joint Applicants to adjust the intervention 
deadline by moving it back one week; 
WHEREAS, counsel for the Joint Applicants, Commission Staff and the DPA all agree 
that the Hearing Examiner is authorized to extend the intervention deadline as requested, by virtue 
of the powers delegated to the Hearing Examiner in Paragraph 2 of Order No. 9831, and under 
Section 2.9.4 of the Rules of Practice and Procedure of the Commission, 26 Del. Admin Code § 
1001-2.9.4; 
WHEREAS, no party objects to the extension of the deadline to intervene as proposed by 
the Joint Applicants and the extension of the deadline will not prejudice Commission Staff, the 
DPA, or any potential intervenor; and 
WHEREAS, there is good cause to extend the intervention deadline so that interested 
parties who become aware of this Docket through publication of the notice have an opportunity to 
timely intervene in the proceeding, 

3 

NOW, THEREFORE, this 1st day of July, 2021, pursuant to the authority granted to me in 
PSC Order No. 9831, dated June 23, 2021, this Hearing Examiner having considered the 
application of the Joint Applicants as described above: 
1. 
The Joint Applicants’ request to extend the intervention deadline to July 14, 2021 
is approved, and the deadline for interested parties to intervene in this Docket is extended to July 
14, 2021. 
2. 
The notice to be published on July 11, 2021, pursuant to Paragraph 3 of Order No. 
9831, will provide the extended intervention deadline of July 14, 2021. 
3. 
All other dates and deadlines for this Docket shall remain as set forth in Order No. 
9831 and Exhibit A thereto. 
BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 
s/s Glenn C. Kenton 
Glenn C. Kenton 
Hearing Examiner
